title: Spammy User Entry Care portal (CGM Sensor insert)
body:
Since a couple of releases, the user entry tab in the Treatments section logs the same message every 5 minutes (see screenshot).

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/af20895f-1aa3-4fab-b527-a660e1848c13)

I'm using a Dexcom G7 with xDrip as collector and data source in AAPS. The screenshot was taken from AAPS 3.3.1.3 (latest Dev from today, 01/02/2025), running the tsunami mod, but the issue appears to be unrelated to the mod.

comments.body: Also see https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3508 for possible solutions. Something has to be done, either on xDrip side or AAPS side, there is nothing decided yet.
I checked one earlier CGM Sensort Spam list. I am sure that earlier it was quite small, may ne 10 lines. Now it was over 110 lines ! Spamming seems to continue and increase the list.

> logs the same message every 5 minutes 

Current dev, using BYODA; not seeing this. So I'd say this is a xDrip+ problem only.

If using xDrip+ and G7 and experiencing this problem, please see https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3804 and test if you want. It fixed the issue for me. I haven't changed G7 session yet with this fix so that is still to confirm.
Fix is now merged to dev branch
Can confirm that new sensor start is received when changing G7. Still no spam. @MilosKozak I think this issue can be closed then.
@piecycle @MilosKozak This issue can be closed due to ce20cccf - tested OK on several sensor changes.
